question: Is the tap count N fixed at build time (a generic), or must one bitstream switch between e.g. 16 and 64 taps at run time?
answer: Fixed at build time: N_TAPS is a synthesis parameter (default 16, legal range 2–64, even or odd). Only coefficient values change at run time, through the shadow bank and commit.

question: Do all 32 channels always use the same coefficients, or must each channel be programmable with its own filter?
answer: Use the default: Each instance holds its own coefficient bank and write port; the wrapper can broadcast one write to all channels
